title: Resolve CODEOWNERS paths
why: A literal CODEOWNERS path that no longer exists cannot assign review ownership to the intended part of the repository.
suggestion: Correct or remove the stale ownership entry, or restore the owned path.
limitations: Only root, .github, and docs CODEOWNERS files are inspected.
Literal non-negated paths without glob or escape syntax are checked; slashless patterns use CODEOWNERS basename semantics, while owner validity is not inferred.
The rule establishes path existence, not whether branch protection requires the listed reviewers.
